metaDescription: Shuttle Meds by Living Dose: emergency help, live doctor calls and mobile clinics for people wey far from hospital. E dey come soon. Join the waitlist.
title: Shuttle Meds: care wey go come meet you
lead: For families wey far from hospital: quick first aid and ambulance, live video call with doctor for few minutes, and mobile clinics wey go visit your area.
emergencyBody: Shuttle Meds never start. Call 112 or go the nearest hospital.

emergency.title: Emergency help
emergency.body: Call for ambulance or person wey sabi first aid, and see dem as dem dey come. Doctor go join the call to guide you until help reach.

doctorCall.title: Doctor for call
doctorCall.body: Live video or voice call with doctor, even if network slow, from anywhere you dey. We build am for towns and villages wey far from clinic.

mobileClinic.title: Mobile clinics
mobileClinic.body: Clinic bus wey dey visit communities on schedule: check-up, BP and blood sugar test, antenatal and pikin health.

medicines.title: Medicine delivery
medicines.body: Medicine wey doctor write for you, we go bring am reach your door or the next place wey mobile clinic go stop.

steps.b: One press for the app, or call our line if you no get data.
For few minutes, doctor go check you by video or voice and decide wetin you need.
We go send first-aid person, ambulance or mobile clinic, or we go deliver medicine.
Your Living Dose care team go check on you after, and everything go save for your records.

waitlistBody: We dey start with pilot communities for South-West Nigeria. Tell us where you dey, and we go let you know when Shuttle Meds reach you.
thanks: Thank you, {{name}}! You don dey the waitlist. We go reach you when Shuttle Meds reach your area.

form.name: Your name
form.contactError: Abeg put phone number or email address.
form.failed: E no go. Abeg check your network and try again.
form.privacy: We go use these details only to tell you about Shuttle Meds.

whereTitle: Where Shuttle Meds go dey serve
whereBody: We dey bring care to where people dey work, learn, gather and live. These ones dey come soon: tell us where you want make we start.

workplace.title: Workplaces
workplace.body: Clinic days for the place, health check for staff, and first aid with ambulance wey dey ready for accident.

education.title: Schools and young people
education.body: School health days, first aid for games and competitions, and doctor for call for students.

community.title: Communities
community.body: Mobile clinic for set days, free test, and doctor by phone for places wey far.

residential.title: Homes and people wey need extra care
residential.body: Regular visit for old people, check-up where e hard to reach clinic, and medicine delivery.

events.title: Big events
events.body: Ambulance and first-aid team for the place for the whole event.

settings.villages: Villages wey far and wey no get enough care
settings.seniors: Homes for old people and estates

bringCta: Bring Shuttle Meds come your place

org.title: Bring Shuttle Meds come your place
org.body: For companies, schools, churches and mosques, markets, estates and people wey dey organise events. Tell us about your place and we go contact you when Shuttle Meds ready for there.
